correctness.rationale: Join-irreducible concepts are distinct object concepts; outside vertices on incidence 4-cycles, degree>=2 rows have unique maximal object intents (except bottom), and degree1 singleton rows yield a join-irreducible iff they exist and at most one higher-degree neighbor shares their attribute. Bad 4-cycle vertices and top/bottom exceptions give |J-Jtilde|<=4Q+2, with transposed dual. For fixed attribute, singleton/higher-degree/nonincident object classes are multinomial with parameters q=p(1-p)^(m-1), h=p[1-(1-p)^(m-1)], giving stated exact mean. E Q=binom(n,2)binom(m,2)(c/n)^4=O(1). Efron-Stein row/column resampling and bounded second degree moments prove variance O(n), yielding joint L1 rate. Duplicate singleton rows with >=2 copies and <=1 higher-degree neighbor yield stated positive Poisson correction.
